title: Random blue screens, suspect faulty RAM
symptom: PC crashes with blue screens at random, often showing MEMORY_MANAGEMENT
user_description: My PC keeps crashing with a blue screen, two or three times a day. I took a photo, it says MEMORY_MANAGEMENT. I've lost work twice now.

options.why: Faulty hardware will keep crashing a fresh install too, and you lose time and settings.

options.text: Add any spare RAM stick you can find in the cabinet
options.why: RAM must match the motherboard (type and speed). A mismatched stick may not fit or may cause more crashes.

options.text: Back up his work, run Windows Memory Diagnostic (mdsched.exe), and if it finds errors, replace the faulty RAM module with a matching one
options.why: The stop code points to memory. A test confirms it before you replace parts, and a matching module fixes it.

options.text: Ignore it unless it happens more often
options.why: Random crashes lose work and can corrupt files. They need fixing.

hints: What does the stop code point to?
How can you confirm the problem before replacing parts?
Does any RAM stick fit any PC?
real_world_tip: Windows Memory Diagnostic runs at the next restart and shows results after you sign in. If you have two sticks, test them one at a time to find the bad one.
